options: The process of converting analogue information into digital format
The strategic use of digital technologies to transform business processes
The sharing of data between organisations
The encryption of digital files
The archiving of old databases
questions.explanation: Digitisation refers to the process of converting analogue information, such as text, images or sound, into digital form represented as binary code.

options: Scanning paper documents into PDF files
The use of digital technologies to transform business processes, activities or models
Converting sound recordings into binary code
Backing up digital files to the cloud
Printing digital documents onto paper
questions.explanation: Digitalisation is a broader concept involving the use of digital technologies to transform business processes, activities or models, going beyond converting analogue data.

questions.stem: Which of these is an example of digitisation?
options: Adopting automation systems to manage operations
Building a digital art gallery to organise and share pictures
Scanning a paper document and converting it into a digital PDF file
Replacing manual processes with software tools
Transforming a business model with digital technology
questions.explanation: Scanning a paper document and converting it into a digital PDF is the example of digitisation: the original exists in analogue form and is converted into a digital representation.

questions.stem: Which of these is an example of digitalisation?
options: Scanning a hand-drawn picture and saving it on a computer
Converting a cassette recording into an MP3 file
Photographing a paper receipt
A business moving from manual, paper-based processes to digital tools, software and automation to manage operations
Typing a handwritten letter into a word processor
questions.explanation: A business transitioning from manual, paper-based processes to digital tools, software and automation systems is the example of digitalisation.

questions.stem: How do digitisation and digitalisation differ in scope?
options: Digitisation is broader, digitalisation is narrower
Both have exactly the same scope
Digitisation applies to businesses, digitalisation applies to individuals
Digitisation covers strategy, digitalisation covers file conversion
Digitisation focuses on converting analogue information, whereas digitalisation encompasses a broader transformation using digital technologies
questions.explanation: In scope, digitisation focuses specifically on converting analogue information into digital form, while digitalisation encompasses a broader transformation of processes, systems or activities.

questions.stem: In terms of process versus strategy, how is digitisation characterised?
options: Primarily a process of converting data, often associated with archival or preservation efforts
A strategic use of digital technologies to drive innovation
A marketing strategy for digital products
A financial strategy to reduce costs
A hiring strategy for technical staff
questions.explanation: Digitisation is primarily a process of converting data, often associated with archival or preservation efforts, whereas digitalisation involves strategic use of digital technologies.

questions.stem: What is the output of digitalisation?
options: Digital versions of existing analogue documents
A transformation in the way activities are conducted, often leading to new and improved processes
Binary code representing scanned images
A backup copy of paper records
A list of country codes
questions.explanation: Digitalisation produces a transformation in the way activities are conducted, often leading to new and improved processes; digitisation produces digital versions of analogue data.

questions.stem: What is the focus area of digitisation?
options: The overall transformation of business models
Company-wide systems and strategy
Individual data items or documents
Customer relationships
Employee training
questions.explanation: Digitisation mainly focuses on individual data items or documents, whereas digitalisation focuses on the overall transformation of business processes, models or systems.

questions.stem: In the hand-drawn pictures analogy, what represents digitalisation?
options: Scanning each picture and saving it on a computer
Drawing the pictures on paper
Storing the paper drawings in a folder
Creating a digital art gallery that stores the pictures and uses digital tools to organise, edit and share them
Printing the scanned pictures
questions.explanation: Scanning each picture is digitisation; creating a digital art gallery where you organise, edit and share the pictures with digital tools is digitalisation.

questions.stem: Which statement about digitisation is NOT correct?
options: It converts analogue data into binary code that computers can understand
It makes existing data easier to store, access and share
It can apply to text, images or sound
It is often associated with archival efforts
It transforms an organisation's entire business model
questions.explanation: Transforming an entire business model describes digitalisation; digitisation is the conversion of individual analogue items into digital form.
